title: Woman Finally Gets What She Deserves
description:
This woman just slapped a man straight across his face and when the rookie officer tried to confront her, she started crying wolf. It’s quite unlikely that she’ll get any justice by walking away from the police and abandoning her case. Her belligerent barking was tiring and those crocodile tears were certainly not fooling these officers into letting her go. We definitely heard more from her than we wanted to, here’s the complete story from the assisting officer. The female’s demeanor worsened on the way to the jail and she even refused to identify herself. The unidentified 48 year old female was booked in as a Jane Doe and she was charged with battery and resisting arrest without violence.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
